fields.source_first_note: Read the complete Rafi ibn Khadij report: Ansar cultivation/sharecropping, uneven productivity of plots, consequent prohibition and the distinct negative that silver rent was not prohibited. The prohibiting actor is not named in this own field, so keep the passive attribution qualified rather than call it direct Prophet speech. The rupees-and-so-on parenthesis is a lexical illustration of silver money and can remain context. Preserve the actual plot contrast and all negatives; initial multistep chain is context, coherent final hearing/reporting frame remains.

Entire own Urdu read independently. Rafi reports their cultivation practice, differing production across field portions and being forbidden that arrangement, while expressly excluding silver rent from the prohibition. Do not infer the unnamed prohibiting speaker. ( روپے وغیرہ ) is an explanatory currency example, not new substantive narration. Retain every causal and negative qualification and the actual final reporter frame; no outside lease rule is added.

Complete Hindi read including damaged introduction/stranded अलैहि वसल्लम) and all final apparatus. Actual Abu Hurayra report supplies the prohibitions on advance greeting of trade caravans, city-selling for a villager, conditioning one sister’s divorce, bidding over another and najsh/tasriya. Retain trade-caravan scope: without it the greeting prohibition broadens. Retain religious-or-kin sister scope as the actual domain of the divorce condition. Later corroborating routes, passive-form label and we-were-forbidden/forbade word-form comparisons give no new body and remain source context. Hindi lacks Urdu’s Nadr and some route words; neither names nor grammar are repaired.

Read every actual prohibition and the full tail. The trade-caravan and religious-or-kin parenthetical qualifiers carry substantive object/recipient scope and stay; all named prohibitions stay literal. The tail consists of corroborating route and active/passive wording comparisons, including its own Nadr/Hajjaj names, not separate new substantive reports. Preserve these as context and do not import the Urdu route or Nadr into the damaged Hindi. No explanatory definition of najsh/tasriya is invented.

Complete Ibn Umar report read: Umar receives Khaybar land, asks counsel, receives conditional retain-land/give-yield advice, then establishes the stated non-sale/non-gift/non-inheritance charity terms with actual beneficiaries and trustee-use conditions. Distinguish the advice exchange from the narrated Umar disposition while keeping one source family. (वक़्फ़) is a technical synonym and can remain context. The final Ibn Awn/Ibn Sirin encounter supplies an actual separately named saying about not intending wealth accumulation; this is eligible under its own speaker, not direct Prophet speech or an unvoiced compiler ruling. Retain (मुतवल्ली) as the explicit subject limitation in that actual final saying. No omitted beneficiary or canonical formulation is filled from elsewhere.

All own Urdu clauses read, including the final reported Ibn Sirin response. Preserve Umar’s land/counsel scene and complete actual endowment conditions: no sale/gift/inheritance, all printed beneficiary groups, ordinary trustee need or provision to a needy person. The waqf apposition defines the preceding charity term and is context. Separately attribute the final no-accumulation-intention statement to Ibn Sirin as conveyed by Ibn Awn, retaining its explicit trustee subject parenthesis. It is an actual named saying within a narrated exchange, not a new Prophet quotation. Earlier pure chain stays context; actual deed and final saying remain in one source family.
